full_name: Kathleen Thelen | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2010–2011 Social Sciences Matina S. Horner Distinguished Visiting Professor Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Kathleen Thelen is the Ford Professor of Political Science at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, a permanent external scientific member of the Max-Planck-Institut für Gesellschaftsforschung, and a senior research fellow at Nuffield College, University of Oxford.
